The basic flow feels right, and newest-first makes sense to me. Seeing the link appear immediately while its details are being fetched is reassuring.

I’d like the saved item to include the page’s actual small site icon and, when available, a preview image—not just a letter. Also, if I paste a link I’ve already saved, I don’t want a duplicate; I’d expect the app to bring up the existing bookmark so I can update it.

With those additions, this saving flow matches what I had in mind.
